'''Kittazap''' is a [[Lightning]] type [[Guardian]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves into [[Nekowatt]] at 6 bronze stars.

==Overview==
Current Description: "Tatari don't seem to realize just how popular Kittazap is among humans. Just wave that paw and here comes food!"

Kittazap is a purple rarity Tatari.

==Appearance==
A sentient [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Maneki-neko maneki-neko], the Japanese figurine and good luck symbol. Instead of holding a coin, Kittazap holds a [[pinball]] with a lightning bolt symbol on it. Kittazap is also yellow with a white underbelly and white paws. One of its ears is brown, and the end of its tail is brown as well. 

Kittazap's [[Tatari#Glitter_Tataris|Glitter]] form changes its yellow fur to gray, and brown fur becomes dark gray. 

== Evolution Trial ==
Kittazap's evolution trial unlocks once it reaches 6 bronze stars/19 copies. To evolve it into [[Nekowatt]] you need to complete the following task:

* Shoot 2,400 pinballs.

==Strategy==
[[File:Kittazap Attack Range.png|x200px|left|thumb|Kittazap's attack range]]
Kittazap is a frontliner, being a Guardian and having minimal range. You should use [[Flameow]]/evo alongside Kittazap because of the Paw Pals bond, giving Kittazap a 3% ATK speed increase.

* Prior to the update on 5/12/2026, its bio description said: "Kittazap loves tossing and retrieving the special lightning pinball. Usually only plays with Flameow and ignores other Tatari."
